## Review checklist

- [ ] Target is `develop`, or this is a release PR from `develop` to `main`.
- [ ] Scope stays within the owner's area; cross-owner changes are explained.
- [ ] Shared contracts and database changes have the relevant owners' review.
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, tests, and production build pass.
- [ ] No secrets, personal student data, or local environment files are included.
- [ ] User-facing text is English and keyboard interaction is supported.
- [ ] Generated code has been read and reviewed.
